theorems.name: Submission.exists_nearby_points_off_bad_sets
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (Bad : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → (∀ i : ℕ, x ∉ interior (⋂ ℓ : ℕ, ⋂ (_ : i ≤ ℓ), Bad ℓ)) → ∃ (q : ℕ → ℕ) (y : ℕ → Euclidean N), Tendsto q atTop atTop ∧ Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) ∧ ∀ i, y i ∈ W ∧ y i ∉ Bad (q i)
